facts.fact: The World Bank mission reports a System Integrator contracted with INIC and DGRN to design and implement a new foundational digital ID, with launch planned by January 2026 and its enabling identity law still awaiting approval.

slug: 2025-06-05 São Tomé and Principe pilots MOSIP-based national digital ID system

facts.fact: A Justice Ministry official says the country is in the pilot phase of a national digital ID on MOSIP, begun in 2024, with no fixed timeline for full-scale deployment.
A tender notice of 14 May 2026 by AFAP seeks servers for the data centre and disaster recovery of the digital identity system.

note: Document only says a valid Bilhete de Identidade copy is required; nothing on the system.

facts.fact: A campaign running until 15 March 2026 gave a free Bilhete de Identidade to citizens over 17 without a valid one, implemented by the Direcao-Geral dos Registos e Notariado with PReSE support.

The Direcao-Geral dos Registos e Notariado is issuing the free Bilhete de Identidade through a brigade in Porto Alegre, Caue district, after Ilheu das Rolas, with EU-funded PReSE supplying Starlink and a generator.
The AFAP, under the World Bank-financed Sao Tome and Principe Digital project, announced a tender for biometric kits for digital identity registration.

facts.fact: India's Ministry of External Affairs says Ooru Digital is implementing a MOSIP-based National Digital Identity system for São Tomé and Príncipe, funded by the World Bank and CDPI.

note: Document covers an automatic voter registration platform and civil registry equipment; no ID system, number or link to one is stated.
The ID system is named but not described as issuing unique credentials.

facts.fact: The Director of Registries and Notaries says a pilot project with MOSIP is preparing the digital identity, with the physical card still unfunded.

note: The document states nothing that answers this study.

facts.fact: Portugal's IRN said it is helping São Tomé and Príncipe's citizen-card project with draft legislation and equipment for future biometric capture and reading.

facts.fact: Ooru Digital, the implementer, says a MOSIP-based national digital identity system anchored in DGRN's SIGA registry is being implemented, with Phase 1 (2025-2026) delivering it.

note: The document states nothing on this study's aspects for this country that the study's questions ask.
Digital identity is named as still to be implemented; no system state stated.

facts.fact: MOSIP says Sao Tome and Principe completed its pilot and moved forward with national rollout.

note: The ID card is issued instantly in Principe, but the article does not say it carries a unique number or biometrics.
Database record line is a database's no, never a fact.

facts.fact: Justice Minister Vera Cravid said the government is developing a new identification system and a new personal ID document holding all of a person's identifiers.

Gleba TV reports that the Directorate-General of Registry and Notary received five biometric enrolment kits for missions abroad, as part of building the National Digital Identity System under the World Bank-financed STP Digital project, with installation due to start from December 2026.
